name: RavenQuest: Rise of Tyrants
summary:
Rise of Tyrants is a major endgame PvE expansion for the MMORPG RavenQuest, introducing complex group-based content, expanding the pet system, and overhauling core progression mechanics. At the heart of the update is the new "Tyrant System," which features five uniquely choreographed boss encounters (such as Sol Xoloth, the Sun King, and Sultan Zaraketh, the Elemental Storm) that rotate weekly. Designed specifically for coordinated five-player parties, these battles move beyond simple stat checks, requiring players to react to phase shifts, environmental hazards, and complex mechanics.

The system introduces "Sigils," an escalating difficulty modifier that allows groups to push for higher tiers of rewards and competitive leaderboard placement. Tied to these bosses is a new permanent progression layer called Relics.

The expansion also introduces Pet Awakening, granting new utility and resources through the game's transmutation loops, alongside a major rework of the Rangers Company hunting tasks featuring a global auto-balancing kill-count system. Additionally, the Munk Carnival social hub expands with new mini-games.
